'''S/ig-37 hyperdrives''' were a type of [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] made by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]]. They were used in [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]].
